./game.message: A decision the local player makes goes through commitDecision in src/decisions.ts, the only place that knows whether this screen is the host, the guest or alone. A branch here is a branch a new decision can forget the guest on - see 02-balticmap/AGENTS.md. The turn-order and lobby moves in this list append events to a GameState the same way a decision does; their wrappers in src/moves.ts are the door for those.

./boot-params.message: applyBootParams appends events to a GameState the same way a decision does. main.ts uses bootGame from src/moves.ts, the one door for that and every other move that is not a decision.

./arrows.message: Every arrow on the map goes through renderArrowScene in src/arrow-scene.ts, which is the only thing that knows about borders and lanes. Geometry here is a fifth kind of arrow with its own rules - see 02-balticmap/CLAUDE.md.
